description: A schema whose every identifier is a reserved word.
rationale: user, order, end, desc and limit are all reserved words that nonetheless match the [a-z0-9_] shape require_identifier permits, so they reach the planner. Measured on 18.6: a schema or table named this way is a syntax error in EVERY position -- CREATE TABLE user.order, and even SELECT ... FROM user.order -- and a column named this way breaks in every DDL position. Only a fully qualified schema.table.column reference survives unquoted, which is why the bug hid. This transcript is the record that every identifier the planner emits is quoted.
